findings.evidence_sql: select "INV_ID","INV_NO","VEND_CD","INV_DT","INV_AMT","JRNL_NO" from "APINVH" where "INV_ID" in (348,802,510,801) order by "INV_ID"
findings.summary: Invoices 801 and 802 re-enter vendor invoices 510 (V0001-57211-510) and 348 (V0014-15732-348): same vendor, date and amount, with INV_NO differing only by leading/trailing spaces. Each has its own journal, so AP and expenses are double-counted.

findings.evidence_sql: select l."JRNL_NO",l."LN_SEQ",l."ACCT_CD",c."ACTV_FLG",l."DR_AMT" from "GLJRNL" l join "GLCOA" c on trim(c."ACCT_CD")=trim(l."ACCT_CD") where c."ACTV_FLG"='N'
findings.summary: Journals 1941 and 2271 post to account 5900 Legacy Miscellaneous, which is inactive (ACTV_FLG=N). The memos say 'charge to 5300 Facilities'. Journal 2271 posts into open period 12.

findings.evidence_sql: select i."INV_ID",i."INV_AMT",sum(p."PAY_AMT") paid from "APINVH" i join "APPAYM" p on p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID" group by 1,2 having sum(p."PAY_AMT")<>i."INV_AMT"
findings.summary: Invoice 509 has INV_AMT 16989.65 and its GL journal 1832 credits AP 16989.65. Payment 325 (journal 1833) is 16989.66, 1 cent more than the invoice, so the settlement does not agree with the invoice it settles.

findings.evidence_sql: select h."JRNL_NO",h."MEMO",l."LN_SEQ",l."ACCT_CD",l."DR_AMT" from "GLJRNH" h join "GLJRNL" l using ("JRNL_NO") where h."JRNL_NO"=2271
findings.summary: Journal 2271 is linked to invoice 770 (INV_AMT 17862.11) and posts DR 5900 10150.12 plus DR 5200 7711.99. 5900 is a retired account, and the memo says the whole invoice is to be charged to 5300 Facilities.

findings.evidence_sql: select "JRNL_NO","PRD_ID","SRC_REF","MEMO","REF_JRNL_NO" from "GLJRNH" where "SRC_CD"='GL' and "SRC_REF" in ('RLOPEZ','MPATEL') order by 1
findings.summary: Manual GL journals in open periods 11 and 12 (e.g. 2323, 2348, 2339) have SRC_REF users RLOPEZ and MPATEL, whom the notes did not list as keyers (only JSMITH and KWONG). All of them are labelled 'Manual accrual', with no reversal.
